info.name: Docsie Air-Gapped Portal Demo
info.description: Build, download, and verify a self-contained Docsie portal. Run the Cloud build API folder first, deploy the downloaded ZIP with the repository scripts, then run the Local offline proof folder. The collection never stores or prints the Docsie API key.

item.name: Cloud build API
item.description: Run these requests in order. In the Collection Runner, the status request polls every five seconds until the build completes. In the request builder, click Send on the status request again until status is complete.

item.name: 1. Create air-gapped build
item.description: Queues the Celery-backed export job. A successful response stores the build ID in the selected Postman environment.

exec: pm.test('Response contains a build ID', function () { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: 2. Poll build status
item.description: Returns pending, processing, complete, or failed. Collection Runner mode loops with a five-second pause and stops after 360 attempts.

exec: pm.test('Build has a known status', function () { pm.expect(allowed).to.include(body.status); });
pm.test('Build completed successfully', function () { pm.expect.fail(body.error_message || 'Air-gapped build failed'); });
pm.test('Polling stayed within the 30-minute limit', function () { pm.expect(attempt).to.be.below(361); });

item.name: 3. Get private download URL
item.description: Issues a short-lived private download URL after the build is complete. The URL is stored as a secret environment value.

exec: pm.test('Download URL was issued', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response contains an HTTPS download URL', function () { pm.expect(body.download_url).to.match(/^https:\/\//); });

item.name: 4. Download ZIP
item.description: Uses the short-lived URL without Docsie API authentication. In the Postman desktop app choose Send and Download and save the file as .artifacts/airgapped-build.zip.

item.name: Local offline proof
item.description: Run after ./scripts/deploy-offline.sh. These requests intentionally use localhost and do not send the Docsie API key.

exec: pm.test('Local portal is available', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Portal declares offline mode', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('window.__DOCSIE_OFFLINE__ = true'); });
